modules.name: Jarvis 2.0
modules.blurb: Install the version of Jarvis that runs a high ticket business, not a side hustle. Research, offer building, outreach, proposals and delivery all come out of this one thing, so it gets built first.

lessons.title: Your Unfair Advantage, Set Up First

modules.name: The Irresistible Offer
modules.blurb: Understand the offer, explore services and niches, then create yours with Jarvis.

lessons.title: What an Irresistible Offer Looks Like

modules.name: Funnels
modules.blurb: This comes before outreach on purpose. Every lead you generate needs a page to land on, a booking step that qualifies them, and follow up that runs without you. A high ticket funnel does not sell. It puts the right person on your calendar already half sold, and your CRM is where all of it lives.

modules.name: Client Acquisition: Outreach
modules.blurb: Build the list, enrich it, then hit it from the phone, LinkedIn, DMs, email and SMS with one message and one pipeline behind it. Channels on their own are a hobby. Packaged together they are a machine.

lessons.title: The Whole System on One Page

modules.name: Client Acquisition: Paid Ads
modules.blurb: Ads do not fix a weak offer, they expose it faster. Once outreach has proven people will pay, this is how you buy the same conversations without picking up the phone.

lessons.title: The Ad Skills: Script, Record, Edit, Statics, Set Up

modules.name: Sales
modules.blurb: Two calls. The first one finds the problem and puts a number on it. The second one presents the thing you scoped and closes it. No pitching in call one, ever.

modules.name: Fulfilment
modules.blurb: Two ways to deliver what you just sold. Arbitrage means somebody technical builds it and you own the client. Self fulfilment means you and Jarvis build it. Most people end up doing both, one per deal.

lessons.title: Arbitrage: Scope, Hand Off, Keep the Margin
